turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I burned the rice. Again. Guests arrive in forty minutes.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Don't panic, there's time. You can start a fresh pot, or switch to couscous, which is ready in five minutes. Which do you prefer?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, I need a minute with my roommate. Just stay silent until I come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Look at this statement. What is this charge from Tuesday?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Let me see. Oh, that's the parking garage downtown.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: That place is a rip off. Next time take the bus with me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I think I will. Do you get a monthly pass?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I do, it pays for itself in about two weeks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is the oven ready yet? The light's still on.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Five more minutes to heat up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back. Thanks for being patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Still about the burned rice. Fresh pot or couscous?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Couscous. I can't face another pot of rice tonight.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good choice. Pour boiling stock over it, cover it for five minutes, then fluff it with a fork and a bit of butter.
